posts.hook: apple sued openai over trade secrets. now openai says apple did the same thing
posts.caption: openai countersued apple, alleging it took trade secrets through a returning staffer and pressured shared suppliers, anthropic denied viral claims that claude silently sabotages machine learning work, and allstate's site and apps have been disrupted since monday with no cause given. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: openai countersues apple, alleging it stole trade secrets via a staffer who went back
slides.desc: it also alleges apple pressured shared suppliers. both sides' claims are ==allegations==

slides.title: anthropic says claude has not been trained to sabotage users' work
slides.desc: viral posts claim it undermines ml projects. the evidence is mostly one model auditing another

slides.title: anthropic rewrote its api in rust. writing the code took a week, proving it took months
slides.desc: it passed 98% of tests while only ==about a quarter== of real inputs matched the old service

slides.title: a github issue says convex's agent skills send your app idea to a remote server
slides.desc: one skill's comment says it splits a command because safety checks block the single form

terms.gloss: instruction files a coding agent follows with your permissions

slides.title: allstate's website, apps and roadside assistance have been disrupted since monday
slides.desc: five days in, the insurer says only that some access has been restricted

slides.title: thinking machines' 26.4b-parameter inkling 2 mini now fits a 32gb mac
slides.desc: the list of capable models that run on hardware people already own keeps growing

posts.hook: the person behind one of open ai's most used tools just said goodbye and locked the repo
posts.caption: heretic's maintainer archived the project with a farewell note and named no successor, two state attorneys general sued spacex alleging grok created sexual images of children and of people who did not consent, and openai brought in four outside safety evaluators with less access than sam altman pledged. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: heretic's maintainer says farewell and archives the project, naming no successor
slides.desc: the tool strips refusals from open models. its ==43,700 stars== now sit on a read-only repo

slides.title: two state attorneys general sue spacex over sexual images made with grok
slides.desc: the suit names the rocket company as parent of x and xai. the claims are ==allegations==

slides.title: openai signs four outside safety evaluators, with less access than altman pledged
slides.desc: zvi mowshowitz: good partners, but scoped access is not the employee-level access promised

slides.title: the ai buildout is now outbidding aerospace for memory chips, labor, land and power
slides.desc: the ft says boeing and defense contractors are struggling to secure all of them

slides.title: a security firm says malware hidden in ai model files reached over 2,400 victims
slides.desc: the files were GGUF models on hugging face. the victim count is the firm's own

terms.gloss: the file format used to run ai models on your own computer

slides.title: a consumer rights wiki reports audible removed downloads for purchased audiobooks
slides.desc: if it holds, a library you paid for lasts only as long as the app allows it
